info.title: Keues API
info.description: Queue and ticket management API: locations, flows, queues, counters, tickets and devices. Authentication is done via the HttpOnly "access_token" cookie (JWT) set by the login and create-admin endpoints.

post.summary: Creates a new service desk.

requestBody.description: Data of the counter to create.

get.summary: Gets all counters desks, optionally filtered by location.

requestBody.description: Data to update the counter.

get.summary: Gets a counter by its identifier.

post.summary:
Calls the next ticket in the queue for the specified counter and notifies
the group's monitors (SignalR, "TicketCalled" event).
post.description:
If the counter already has a ticket in progress, the same ticket is called again.
If there are no tickets waiting for the counter's queues, returns 200 with null body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the counter making the call.

requestBody.description: FlowId used to build the SignalR group.

post.summary:
Marks a ticket as attended and notifies the group's monitors
(SignalR, "TicketAttended" event).
post.description:
The counter is resolved from the path id (for the SignalR group),
while the command uses the CounterId from the body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the counter that attends.

requestBody.description: CounterId, TicketId and FlowId of the operation.

post.summary: Cancels a ticket (the customer leaves, closing time, etc.).
post.description: The path id (counter) is not used; the ticket is identified by its TicketId in the body.

requestBody.description: TicketId of the ticket to cancel.

post.summary:
Manually calls a ticket/code and notifies the group's monitors
(SignalR, "TicketCalled" event). Flow for manual calls (fishmonger, greengrocer...).
post.description: The path id is not used; counter, location and flow are taken from the body.

requestBody.description: Code, FlowId, LocationId and CounterId of the manual call.

post.summary:
Notifies that the service desk is free (Carrefour style) to the group's monitors
(SignalR, "CounterFree" event).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the counter that becomes free.

requestBody.description: FlowId used to build the SignalR group.

post.summary:
Transfers a ticket from one queue to another, allowing the customer to change their service type.
THe ticket is put in waiting status in the new queue.
Check if the user has access to the counter. Returns 200 if access is granted, 403 if not.

get.summary: Gets the dashboard summary for a location (KPIs, in progress, waiting by queue, and activity per hour).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional date of the day to query. By default, the current day in UTC.

get.summary: Gets the registered devices, including their real-time connection status.

delete.summary: Deletes a device from the database. Only allowed if it is disconnected.

400.description: Validation or business rule error (does not exist or is still connected).

get.summary: Retrieves all flows, optionally filtered by location.

post.summary: Creates a new service flow.

requestBody.description: Data of the flow to create.

get.summary: Retrieves a flow by its identifier.

requestBody.description: Data to update. The Id in the body is overridden by the path one.

post.summary: Creates a new location.

requestBody.description: Data of the location to create.
Data to update.

get.summary: Retrieves a location by its identifier.

post.summary: Creates a new queue.

requestBody.description: Data of the queue to create.

get.summary: Retrieves all queues, optionally filtered by location.

requestBody.description: Data to update. The Id in the body is overridden by the path one.

get.summary: Retrieves a queue by its identifier.

post.summary: Issues a new ticket in the specified queue. The id of the queue and the flowId of who generates it.

requestBody.description: FlowId of the flow that generates the ticket.

get.summary: Gets the tickets, filterable by status, date range, code, location, or queue.
Gets a ticket by its identifier.
Gets the history of a ticket by its identifier.

post.summary: Create a new user group

requestBody.description: The user group information

get.summary: Get a user group by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user group

200.description: The user group with the specified ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user group to update

requestBody.description: The updated user group information

delete.summary: Delete a user group by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user group to delete

204.description: No content if the deletion is successful

post.summary: Creates the first administrator of the system. Returns the JWT in the body and sets it in the "access_token" cookie.

requestBody.description: Administrator name, email, and password.

post.summary: Logs in a user (administrator or regular user). Returns the JWT in the body and sets it in the "access_token" cookie.

requestBody.description: User email and password.

get.summary: Indicates whether an administrator has already been created in the system.
Gets the data of the authenticated user. Requires the "access_token" cookie.

post.summary:
Requests a password reset. If the email exists, sends an email with a recovery link.
Always responds 200 to avoid revealing whether the email is registered.

requestBody.description: User email.

post.summary: Resets the password using the token received by email.

requestBody.description: Token, email, and new password.

400.description: Invalid, expired token, or another error.

post.summary: Logs out by deleting the "access_token" cookie.
Create a new User. Only accessible by Admins. Returns the created user.

put.summary: Update a new User. Only accessible by Admins. Returns the updated user.

get.summary: Gets a user by its identifier. Only accessible by Admins. Returns the user.

post.summary: Enable or disable a user. Only accessible by Admins. Returns the updated user.

authorizedUserGroups.description: Grupos de usuarios autorizados para este counter

TicketStatus.description: TicketStatus values: 0 = Waiting, 1 = InProgress, 2 = Attended, 3 = Canceled.

queues.description: Colas a las que tiene acceso este counter

authorizedUserGroups.description: Grupos de usuarios autorizados para este counter

access_token.description: HttpOnly cookie with the JWT. It is obtained by calling POST /api/users/login or POST /api/users/create-admin.
access_token.name: access_token

bearer.description: JWT sent in the "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header. Same token returned in the body by POST /api/users/login and POST /api/users/create-admin; use it for non-browser clients that cannot rely on the HttpOnly cookie.
